description:
Immutable deployment evidence for one controlled instrumentation-overhead measurement.

The document deliberately omits its own artifact identifier. The Session
catalog supplies that identity, and the authoritative capture config binds
it when converting this evidence into [`CaptureInstrumentationConfig`].

baseline_duration_ns.description: Duration of the uninstrumented reference workload.

emitted_event_count.description: Number of target events emitted during the instrumented workload.

instrumentation_method.description: Exact target-side instrumentation API or marker method.

instrumented_duration_ns.description: Duration of the same workload with instrumentation enabled.

transport.description: Exact adapter-owned transport used by the measured event stream.

title: InstrumentationOverheadEvidenceDocument
